recognize_zh: 這顆細胞的核呈腎形（kidney-shaped），凹陷深度不到核寬度的一半，染色質已濃縮，細胞質淡粉紅並充滿細小特異顆粒，符合後髓細胞（metamyelocyte）。
features: Cell slightly larger than adjacent red cells
Eccentric kidney-shaped nucleus with shallow indentation (less than half the nuclear width)
Abundant pale pink-lilac cytoplasm with numerous fine specific granules
Background of normocytic red cells in peripheral blood
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a single granulocytic precursor among normocytic red cells. The cell has a kidney-shaped nucleus with a shallow indentation, condensed chromatin and no nucleoli, and abundant pale cytoplasm filled with specific granules. Findings are consistent with a neutrophilic metamyelocyte; its presence in blood suggests a left shift (e.g. infection, inflammation, marrow stress) and should prompt review for additional immature forms.

ddx.vs: In a band the nuclear indentation exceeds half the width of the nucleus, producing a C- or S-shaped band of uniform thickness, whereas this nucleus is only shallowly indented.
Myelocytes have a round to oval nucleus without indentation and often a visible Golgi clearing.
Monocytes have folded nuclei with lacy chromatin and gray-blue cytoplasm with fine dust-like granules and vacuoles, not the pink specific granules seen here.
